hero.description: NexPark automates the entire parking workflow — from online reservation and instant check-in to accurate fee calculation. Efficient. Transparent. Smart.

features.section_title:
Everything you need,
in one platform.
features.f1_desc: Customers choose a building, enter their plate number, and pay the deposit. The system locks the slot instantly — no more losing your spot.
features.f2_desc: Guards record vehicle entry/exit by plate number or booking code. The system calculates fees and generates receipts automatically.
features.f3_desc: Day/night pricing windows with 15-minute grace period and Vietnamese currency rounding rules built in.
features.f4_desc: Managers monitor occupancy, revenue, vehicle counts, and configure pricing in real time.
features.f5_desc: Register a fixed plate number and pay upfront. The system automatically downgrades when the pass expires.

how_it_works.step1_desc: Choose a parking building, enter your plate number, and pay the 5,000 ₫ deposit online. Your slot is immediately reserved.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Arrive at the parking facility. The guard confirms your entry within 45 minutes of your scheduled time. The clock starts.
how_it_works.step3_desc: The system calculates the exact fee based on your actual parking duration. Pay by cash or QR code and drive out.

pricing.monthly_desc: Register a fixed plate number and pay upfront. Automatically downgraded when expired.

user_types.driver_desc: Book your spot online before you arrive, get instant confirmation, and never worry about finding a space.
user_types.staff_desc: A simple dashboard to record vehicle entry and exit. Managers configure pricing and view reports.

cta.headline:
Your parking facility,
smarter starting today.
cta.description: Get started with NexPark — no complex setup, no special hardware required.
